property: Google's BBRv3 branch continues the BBR model-based congestion-control lineage with substantial control/model changes while remaining a distinct development branch from current torvalds/linux mainline BBR.

date_or_range.notes: Exact v2→v3 branch chronology remains to be reconstructed.

sources.supports: mainline remains a distinct classic BBR lineage as reviewed

negative_claims: This edge does not claim that BBRv3 has been merged into current mainline Linux.
A Google development branch is not automatically equivalent to distribution defaults or general deployment.
open_questions: Recover exact BBRv2→v3 fork and patch chronology.
Track future mainline adoption of v2/v3 concepts.
